verdict.rationale: A file named jabber.exe in C:\ProgramData is run with /u /s /i:<pastebin URL> and a .dll argument, which matches regsvr32-style proxy execution (Register Server, /i to fetch a remote scriptlet) that pulls remote content and runs it under a signed Microsoft binary, spawned from cmd.exe. The binary name is masquerading, and the invocation is consistent with a remote payload delivery and execution chain.
